text.text: Waterfront blocked by industrial and godown uses, limiting public access.
Exposed roadside pipes obstruct pedestrian movement.

On the ground, the edge feels closed. Warehouse walls stand where the sea should be, and buildings press close, with no room left for play. Narrow roads leave people and motorbikes to share one strip, and bus stops are far, so many people drive.
High building density leaves little space for public recreation.
A busy road acts as a barrier.
Distant bus stops increase dependence on private vehicles.
Narrow roads force pedestrians and vehicles to share unsafe space.
